data.narrative:
Nuview is a Series A space and aerospace company founded by Clint and Katie Graumann that has raised $22.9M to date. The valuation analysis triangulates across a universe of 5 public comparables and 8 private peers in the Space & Aerospace sector, including publicly traded operators like Rocket Lab (RKLB) and Planet Labs (PL), as well as private companies including SpaceX, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

Two valuation methods proved applicable. The stage-progression method, using total capital raised ($23M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage step-ups, implies a valuation of $46M. The peer-median method across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B, Series B), Aalyria ($1.3B, Series B), and Starcloud ($1.1B, Seed)—yields a median of $1.3B. The public-comp anchoring method proved inapplicable due to lack of disclosed revenue data for the target.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $39M (low) to $1.5B (high), with a median of $673M across the two applicable methods. This wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Nuview's stage-appropriateness relative to peers and the heterogeneity of Space & Aerospace valuations. Resolution hinges on clarity regarding revenue generation or traction relative to the Series B cohort.
